label: D1 after a rewarded rare a1->S2 transition (earlier in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). It fires when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_action 1 and prev_common 0 hold 88% of activation mass), and mostly when that trial was rewarded (in_rew = 1 holds 95% of mass). In model-based terms this is the rare-rewarded switch signal for a1, telling the agent to switch to a2. All variables are observed at D1. The mirror case (a2 rare to S1) almost never fires it, so it is specific to action and state. It also depends on time in the episode: it is silent after about trial 80 and weaker after trial 40. Adding ep_trial < 70 raises dev precision from 0.56 to 0.76 (F1 from 0.58 to 0.66, mass recall 0.83). Without the ep_trial term the predicate gets dev F1 0.58. The strongest activations are rare-rewarded a1 trials. Missed activations are weak (about 16% of mass) and occur on other D1 steps, e.g. after rare-unrewarded a1 trials or common transitions. The model policy at these steps is near-indifferent (choice logit roughly between -1.5 and 2.8).
